assumptions: Paired equipment-loot diagnostic, not measured player pace. Both arms use the frozen full-slot-ready rule, Mines-first-either-family policy, historical personal loot identities, ordered Essences, idle outcomes and 6/24/72/240 cadence-hour checkpoints, seven selected supplies and twelve total attempts. The include-dungeon-loot arm retains equipment from production miniboss and completion acquisition/claim services and reselects legal highest-stat-budget gear before the next attempt. The supplies-only control projects identical reward rules but deliberately withholds those items to reproduce the earlier exclusion. Miniboss rewards stay pending until terminal completion; any later failure loses them. A Vigor-terminal miniboss never reaches its reward callback. Entry snapshot equipment never changes inside a dungeon. Blueprint drops and per-family pity use production rules and are recorded unspent. Every callback and terminal claim is checked for retry idempotence; every reward projection is replayed from its prior state. The fixed route excludes Treasury and retreat. No ordinary currency, creature loot, monster cores, crafting, level/mastery growth, caches, purchases, sigil conversion or dismantling income is credited. Fresh family-ordinal combat panels are shared across arms; reward randomness uses the native owner/run/layout identity, not a new combat seed allocation. No search, policy tuning, retry, sample extension, boss or supply-cadence change. Completion remains seven purchased supply items, not a minimum useful Tower loadout.
